notes.title: Kalevania 1.2.0 released!
notes.content:
- Optimization and bug fixes
- Screen Flashing can now be adjusted from the pause menu
- Boss fights of the last level have been slightly adjusted

notes.title: Kalevania 1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reworked few music tracks both for the upcoming ost version and the game
[*] Simplified the "up-strike" to better match keyborad layout, it is no longer required to have the full power meter when performing this action
[*] Made the ladder mechanics simplified for keyboard use, Väinämöinen will now automatically grab the ladder if jump button is not held
[*] Created a small delay to prevent un-wanted bogo-jumping when falling down a ledge
[*] Bogo jumping to trampoline now activates the trampoline
[*] Now the weapon and rune spell toggle buttons / keys can be adjusted
[*] Fixed hard mode beaten- achievement
[*] Lowered player gravity a tiny bit to help players make the difficult jumps
[*] Game now automatically activates full screen mode on the beginning (requested by Steam Deck players)
[*] Better buy mechanics and on screen info when visiting Ilmarinen's shop in the starting village
[*] General tweaks and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Kalevania hotfix 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.03

-Added possibility to adjust the screen flashing effect. (press backspace during gameplay).
I will add a pause menu item for this in a later update.

-Small fixes and updates

notes.title: Kalevania 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.02 released!

https://store.steampowered.com/gfxproxy/betagfx/apps/2387950/manuals/Kalevania_Readme_1.0.2_.pdf?t=1683578892

-Added hard mode
(can be chosen when starting a new game).

-Customizable action buttons
(Access pause menu during gameplay to change action keys / buttons)

-Better color coding
-Adjustable screen shake
-Better scrolling
-Performance optimization
-Many tweaks and fixes
-Last boss save point enabled
-Added quit function to esc button (hold for 5 seconds)
-Added support for Ä and Ö letters :)
